title: [review] provisioning.py:613: provision_node() never invokes callback
description: The high-level provision_node() method successfully provisions a node (lines 578-613) but never calls self._provisioned_callback. The callback is only invoked in _handle_br_post() (line 368), which is a different code path reached via render_post(). Users of the high-level API will never receive the callback they registered via for_br(provisioned_callback=...). Either provision_node() should invoke the callback before returning, or the docstring should clarify that callers must handle registration themselves.
close_reason: Fixed: Added callback invocation in provision_node() after successful ACK verification (lines 614-626). Now matches _handle_br_post() behavior. All 25 tests pass.
